sections.label: Russia invasion of Ukraine reminder
sections.summary: Russia's invasion of Ukraine reminds that independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity must never be taken for granted.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Russia’s invasion of its neighbour Ukraine is a striking reminder that we must never take our independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity for granted.

sections.label: US-China superpower rivalry
sections.summary: Superpower rivalry between the US and China continues to sharpen, with increasing risks of mishaps and geopolitical miscalculations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Superpower rivalry between the United States (US) and China continues to sharpen, with increasing risks of mishaps and geopolitical miscalculations.

sections.label: UN marine biodiversity negotiations
sections.summary: Negotiations under Singapore's Presidency concluded on a new UN Agreement on Marine Biological Diversity of Areas Beyond National Jurisdiction.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: For example, we have just successfully concluded negotiations under Singapore’s Presidency on a new United Nations Agreement on Marine Biological Diversity of Areas Beyond National Jurisdiction.

sections.label: MFA consular services plan
sections.summary: MFA will meet increased demand and deliver consular services promptly and effectively using technology and a new corps of professional first responders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: MFA will meet this increased demand and deliver consular services to all Singaporeans promptly and effectively, by harnessing technology as well as through a new corps of professional first responders trained to provide 24/7 consular response and assistance to Singaporeans.

sections.label: Singapore resilience and unity
sections.summary: With citizen understanding, trust and support, Singapore will chart its own course, safeguard resilience and unity, and navigate challenges and opportunities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: With understanding, trust, and support from our citizens, Singapore will be on a stronger footing to chart our own course and act in our best interests.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Despite the fraught external environment, we have invaluable strengths, including our reputation for stability and policy consistency, as well as high levels of public trust and support — which we do not take for granted.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We will continue to safeguard and shore up our resilience and unity as Singaporeans, in Singapore or overseas, to navigate the challenges and seize the opportunities ahead.
